video_title: Donovan Mitchell & T-Mac On Mental Training, Positive Affirmations & Mentoring The Next Generation

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the mental challenge of maintaining high-level performance throughout the NBA season
quotes.excerpt: when you really have nothing left, what you going to do for the rest of the week?
quotes.quote: The conditioning, the mental conditioning. I can run, I work my butt off, that's a no-brainer for me, but now it's up here. When you really have nothing left, what you going to do for the rest of the week? How you going to prepare? How you going to fuel? How you going to sleep? That's the mental, how bad do you want it?

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on using positive affirmations to build confidence and mental strength
quotes.excerpt: positive affirmation is crazy. I used to speak to myself. I used to talk to myself.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing that I've learned the past two years is positive affirmation is crazy. I used to speak to myself. I used to talk to myself. I would look at myself in the mirror and talk to myself through the mirror because I felt like I'm talking to a bunch of Tracy McGrady's through that mirror, not just the one that I'm seeing. I feel like my powers, I'm gaining. I feel like I'm talking to a bunch of me looking at myself through the mirror and I feel somebody's going to respond back to me and I'm going to get that power from them, having that conversation and talking to myself.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the importance of self-belief and ignoring external criticism
quotes.excerpt: when you get to your darkest moments, those positive conversations and that's what I was talking about
quotes.quote: You realize when you get to your darkest moments, those positive conversations and that's what I was talking about when I'm doing them drills, you talk to yourself, like, man, you good, this is what you do. It's just motivation and different stuff. I used to use the negativity of Twitter, of all that stuff to fuel you, but when you get to a point where you're no longer underrated, everybody knows who you are and there's an expectation, you can't necessarily use that. You got to go and be like, no, this is who you are, this is who I got to be on a daily basis, and that's every single day.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the necessity of exhaustive preparation to handle unpredictable game results
quotes.excerpt: I exhausted everything to prepare for this. So if you could walk away and feel like you gave
quotes.quote: Are you prepared? When you step on that court, you got to know deep down inside, I've done everything in my willpower to prepare for this situation. And whatever the results are, we just going to live with that, right? Because a lot of that stuff is out of our control. But I know for me, man, I exhausted everything to prepare for this. So if you could walk away and feel like you gave it all, like you was prepared mentally, physically, spiritually, all that, and the results didn't work out for you, well then the cards, it wasn't for you. You can go to sleep at night.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the collective effort required to win an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: it takes a lot to win a championship. It takes a lot of skill, takes a lot of luck
quotes.quote: It takes a lot to win a championship. It takes a lot of skill, takes a lot of luck, it takes a lot of all these different things, but a lot of things are out of the control of one human. You got to understand that there's so much that goes into it and you can't sleep because you didn't win, but you're able to be like, for this past season, I said, man, all right, I did everything I thought I knew I had. There's another level.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on his supportive relationship with high school prospect Mikal Brown
quotes.excerpt: I don't give a damn if you go to Louisville. I just want to see you be
quotes.quote: I don't give a damn if you go to Louisville. I just want to see you be the best you can be. If you go to Louisville, I will be there to support you. If you don't go, like, I tell everybody that. I want you to go, I would love for you to go, but at the end of the day, I'm here to help you. And that's what I tell every single kid.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on mentoring young players like Mikal Brown who pay attention to details
quotes.excerpt: I'm having conversations with him like I'm talking to James Harden. He's asking about the low man
quotes.quote: I'm having conversations with him like I'm talking to James Harden. I'm sitting here like, bro, how old are you? He's like, I'm 16, 17. I'm like, what? Like, he's asking about the low man, he's asking about strong side help, he's asking about gap help, he's asking about pickups, he's asking about, like, I'm sitting here like, a lot of kids in high school do it, but they don't know what they're doing. And that's one thing I really respected about him and he was like, man, I want to work, I just want to work.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on the value of young players seeking advice from experienced veterans
quotes.excerpt: you were the same way with Dominique. Asking questions, what you see about my game? What's this?
quotes.quote: You were the same way with Dominique. Asking questions, what you see about my game? What's this? What's that? It was dope to see because it was time to, you've talked about this a lot, young guys aren't like that. And you know it now because you're in it. And I was in it, I'm six years removed from it, but I was in it where young guys don't, aren't like that. And it was kind of dope to see Darius Garland was like that. You guys are asking questions to get better. I'm like, just because you here, man, you trying to stay. And what's wrong with asking from people who's already been through it and taking stuff from it?
